# Healify

Healify is an open-source (MIT) tool that fixes broken test selectors. It runs 100% locally — no AI, no cloud, no account. When a locator fails, it reads the DOM evidence your framework already captured, finds the element by its ARIA role and accessible name, and tells you which stable selector to use instead. `healify fix` applies the change to your code.

Healify es una herramienta open source (MIT) para arreglar selectores de test rotos. Corre 100% local, sin IA, sin nube y sin cuenta.

- Version: 2.7.0 (Latest)
- Status: 1113 tests passing, 8 npm packages, CI 13/13
- Language: TypeScript (engines >= 18.0.0)
- Author: Matías Escobar (Rosario, Argentina)
- License: MIT

## What makes it different

Most tools in this space need Docker with Postgres, or send your DOM to an LLM. Healify is **deterministic heuristics**: same input, same output, every time. Nothing leaves your machine. That matters for confidentiality (banks, government), cost (no tokens to pay) and auditability (a suggestion can be explained; a model can't).

It never proposes a concrete replacement without confirming the element against a real page. A suggestion carries `verified: true` only when Healify actually found it in the DOM.

## Supported frameworks

Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, WebdriverIO — including shadow DOM, iframes, and selectors that live in page objects rather than in the test.

Other languages talk to the engine over JSON on stdin/stdout: Python (`pip install healify-selenium`), Java (`io.github.mescobar996:healify-selenium` on Maven Central), C# (reference adapter).

## @healify/* packages

- @healify/reporter-core: the engine — heuristics, verification, reporting
- @healify/test-runner: Playwright reporter
- @healify/cypress-plugin: Cypress plugin, includes `cy.healifyGet()` for live healing
- @healify/selenium-plugin: WebDriver wrapper, heals in place without touching the test
- @healify/webdriverio-plugin: v8+ wrapper
- @healify/ai-local: optional local AI (Ollama) for explanations — off by default, never decides a fix
- @healify/cli: doctor, init, fix, report, dashboard, flake, watch, explain

## Integrations

- **GitHub Action**: comments broken selectors on every PR, never modifies files
- **Defect reporting**: files each broken selector as a Jira ticket or GitHub issue, with evidence and steps. Deduplicated by a stable defect id, opt-in and off by default
- **VS Code extension**: underlines fragile selectors as you type; the ones that actually broke get a verified Quick Fix

## Quick start

```
npx @healify/cli init
```
